monk.definition:
n. a male religious living in a cloister and devoting himself to contemplation and prayer and work
n. United States jazz pianist who was one of the founders of the bebop style (1917-1982)
monk.translation: n. 修道士, 僧侣, 和尚

monkeries.translation: n. 修道生活, 修行, 庙宇( monkery的名词复数 )

monkery.definition:
n. The life of monks; monastic life; monastic usage or
   customs; -- now usually applied by way of reproach.
n. A collective body of monks.
monkery.translation: n. 修道院生活, 修道院, 僧侣
